_what: Route 1's instruments and palette, read by composer.py. A part's family decides whether route 1 may render it (the palette); an instrument file renders client music only when its row says paid_ads yes. Unknown instruments are refused until a row is added from the licence itself.
_read: 2026-10-27, from lab record lab-00018 (not shipped) (licence pages read that day). Re-read a licence older than six months before relying on its row.

blocked.solo_strings: exposed solo strings give a sample mockup away (practitioners: bow-change legato is 'kryptonite for samples')
blocked.winds: solo winds sound cheap from samples
blocked.vocals: route 1 does not render voices; AI vocals are route 2, case by case, with their record
